description.value: Reduces the penalty for firing beyond the weapon's first range increment by 1.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Reduces the penalty for firing beyond the weapon's first range increment by 1" has no rule-element equivalent: pf2e's multiple-range-increment penalty (-2 per increment beyond the first) is a fixed engine calculation, not exposed as an adjustable selector/property anywhere -- confirmed against item-alteration/handlers.ts's full property list (has range-increment and range-max, i.e. how far an increment reaches, but nothing for the per-increment penalty amount itself) and 0 hits for any range-penalty selector across pf2e-source. Real pf2e's closest analog (Advanced Rangefinder, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/advanced-rangefinder.json) achieves a similar practical effect by lengthening the range increment itself, not by reducing the penalty per increment -- a different mechanism than what this card states, so substituting it would misrepresent the card rather than implement it.
